question: For alien data, how many of the top 10 states by alien population have a higher percentage of friendly aliens than hostile aliens, with an average alien age exceeding 200?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as qualifying_states_count
FROM (
    WITH top_10_states AS (
        SELECT state, COUNT(*) as population
        FROM alien_data
        GROUP BY state
        ORDER BY population DESC
        LIMIT 10
    ),
    state_metrics AS (
        SELECT 
            state,
            AVG(age) as avg_age,
            SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as friendly_count,
            SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hostile_count,
            COUNT(*) as total_count
        FROM alien_data
        WHERE state IN (
            SELECT state FROM top_10_states
        )
        GROUP BY state
    )
    SELECT state
    FROM state_metrics
    WHERE avg_age > 200 
      AND (friendly_count * 1.0 / total_count) > (hostile_count * 1.0 / total_count)
) as result
